content:
megan (Marketing): Heads-up — I uploaded a one-slide quickspark for the field: 'Deploy options & SLAs — QuickSpark'. Need a fast pass before we push to the playbook. 

sam (Growth): Thanks! Can you drop the link? I want to wire it into the inbound routing flow and the webinar CTAs.

megan (Marketing): https://redwood.example/s/qs-deploy-options (preview in thread). It's intentionally short — headline, 3 rows (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), quick SLA callouts, and 2 CTAs: 'Book demo' + 'Request SOC review'.

jess (Product): Nice. For SLAs let's use numbers we can guarantee: Hosted: 99.9% uptime, p99 < 120ms for small models; Dedicated: 99.95% uptime, p99 < 80ms depending on proc; Private: SLA is contractual — recommend 'negotiable with reserved capacity'. Keep wording conservative.

marco (Field): Agree with conservative SLAs. For sales enablement add one short sentence on routing logic: 'Smart routing can fallback to compatible model variants to preserve uptime'. Gives SREs cover.

carla (Design): I can tighten the slide real quick. Two asks: 1) Preferred color for SLA badges (green/amber/red?), 2) Do we want icons for each deploy mode or keep text-only?

megan (Marketing): 1) green for Hosted, teal for Dedicated, navy for Private. 2) icons would help scannability — please add small infra-style icons. Keep file lightweight for download.

jake (Demand): For the webinar landing page we need a short benchmark snip to increase conversions. Suggest a single line under Hosted: "median latency 35ms on conversational workloads (internal benchmark)" — but flag as internal. Could we phrase as 'typical median latency ~35ms* (internal benchmark)' with a footnote?

jess (Product): Fine if we mark it as internal benchmark and add an asterisk pointing to 'benchmark conditions vary; contact sales for workload-specific numbers'.

kelsey (PMM): For messaging iteration — let's test two CTAs in the field: 1) Book a 15-min demo, 2) Request an enterprise readiness pack (SLA + security checklist). We'll route demo clicks to growth, readiness pack to solutions. Add tiny UTM tags for tracking.

sam (Growth): Routing notes — please make the buttons trigger different lead tags: demo -> lead_type=demo_quickspark, readiness -> lead_type=readiness_pack. We'll put a webhook mapping in the playbook.

marco (Field): One more ask — add an FAQ microcopy line: 'Can you run models I already use?' Short answer: 'Yes — we support open models and private uploads; we recommend testing on Dedicated before Private rollouts.'

megan (Marketing): I'll fold those in. Plan: Carla updates design, Jess confirms SLA copy, Kelsey prepares two micro-variants for A/B CTA testing, Sam wires lead tags, Jake drafts the benchmark blurb for the landing page. Target: ship to field assets + webinar slide by EOD Friday. :rocket: 

carla (Design): On it — I can have two PNG sizes and an SVG. Will drop in the asset folder with the naming convention `quickspark_deploy_options_v1.{svg,png}`

jake (Demand): I'll draft the landing blurb and two email headers for the webinar: short and long. Short: 'How to pick your inference deployment: cost, latency, security' Long: 'Choosing an inference deployment for enterprise apps — comparing Hosted, Dedicated, and Private with real benchmarks'.

jess (Product): For compliance line, add: 'KMS, audit logs, and SOC2-ready controls available for Dedicated and Private.' Keep it short.

megan (Marketing): Perfect. I'll update the slide copy now and ping this thread when the asset is live. If anyone has final word changes, drop them here before 3pm.

sam (Growth): If possible, add UTM template in the slide comments so field reps can paste. e.g., `?utm_source=field&utm_campaign=quickspark&utm_medium=onepager&utm_content={{cta}}`

marco (Field): Great. Once assets live I'll prep the inbound routing doc for SDRs and add sample responses for SOC requests.

megan (Marketing): Done — uploaded updated slide and PNGs. Link: https://redwood.example/s/qs-deploy-options/v1 (files: quickspark_deploy_options_v1.svg + pngs). Updated copy reflects conservative SLAs and the benchmark footnote.

carla (Design): Confirmed. Files look good. I added alt text and a small notes box for reps.

kelsey (PMM): I'll create two micro-variants for the field deck and set up the A/B test plan. Will post the test plan doc tomorrow.

jake (Demand): Uploaded landing draft to /marketing/webinar/quickspark. I've included the short benchmark line with the asterisk and footnote.

marco (Field): Routing doc ready draft — will drop in #sales-playbooks and link it in the asset comments.

megan (Marketing): Thanks team. Closing loop: target ship = Friday EOD; follow-ups in separate threads: webinar creative, A/B test plan, and routing webhook mapping.

sam (Growth): :thumbsup: 

megan (Marketing): if anyone needs final edits after 3pm, DM me. Otherwise this thread archived.
